function.name: spawn_subagent
function.description: Delegate a goal to a new subagent that works in parallel. Choose the kind of agent best suited to the goal. Its result is reported back to you when it finishes.

kind.description: Which kind of agent to spawn (the role best suited to the goal, e.g. "worker").

goal.description: The goal to delegate to the subagent.

termination.description: Lifecycle policy. 'auto' (default): one-shot — the subagent is removed as soon as it returns its result. 'manual': persistent — after returning its result the subagent stays alive and idle so you can watch it, give it more work, or delete it with delete_subagent.
